# Rajlakshmi Javiks International - Organic Food Provider

Rajlakshmi Javiks International is a premier manufacturer, distributor, and B2B supplier of 100% certified organic food products based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, with a manufacturing unit in Pune, Maharashtra.

## Products & Categories
We specialize in providing high-quality, lab-tested, and chemical-free agricultural products:
- Pure A2 Bilona Ghee from indigenous grass-fed cows.
- Cold-pressed organic oils (Mustard, Coconut, Groundnut) extracted via Kacchi Ghani methods.
- Unpolished, organic grains, pulses, and ancient millets.
- Sun-dried authentic organic spices and masalas (high curcumin turmeric, cumin).
- Premium, sulfur-free dry fruits and nutrient-dense seeds.
- Hand-made traditional aachar (pickles) and fruit chutneys.

## Certifications & Quality Assurance
We hold rigorous certifications guaranteeing the purity of our products:
- FSSAI Certified.
- 100% Organic Certified (No synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or GMOs).
- Third-party Lab Tested for over 100+ parameters including heavy metals and pesticide residues.

## B2B & Wholesale Services
We cater to retailers, supermarkets, HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, Cafes), Ayurvedic wellness centers, and exporters.
- Flexible Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ).
- Private labeling and white-labeling organic food manufacturing.
- Pan-India fast logistics network.
